verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email product, since email servers can be self-hosted, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Gmail can be self-hosted: every documented capability is Google-hosted (the REST API, IMAP/POP/SMTP access to Google's servers, Workspace). Community mentions of self-hosted Dovecot describe users leaving Gmail, not a Gmail capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
